# appsignal_trigger (Resource)

A metric trigger (anomaly detection) in an AppSignal app. AppSignal never changes a trigger in place: every change archives the trigger and creates a new version with a new id, which also closes the alerts that were open on the old version.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "appsignal_trigger" "queue_depth" {
  app_id              = appsignal_app.web.id
  kind                = "Advanced"
  name                = "Queue depth"
  description         = "Jobs are piling up; check the workers."
  metric_name         = "queue_depth"
  field               = "gauge"
  tags                = { queue = "default" }
  comparison_operator = ">"
  threshold           = 500
  warmup_duration     = 5
  cooldown_duration   = 5
  notifier_ids        = [data.appsignal_notifier.email.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String)
- `comparison_operator` (String) One of !=, <, <=, ==, >, >=.
- `field` (String) Metric field to compare: mean, p90, p95, count, gauge, counter.
- `kind` (String) Trigger kind. Use `Advanced` for custom metrics. The provider passes the metric, field and tags through as given; to copy the exact shape of a built-in kind, create the trigger in the AppSignal UI and import it.
- `metric_name` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `threshold` (Number) Value the metric is compared with.

### Optional

- `cooldown_duration` (Number) Minutes the condition must be gone before an alert closes. Defaults to 0.
- `dashboard_id` (String) Dashboard linked from notifications.
- `description` (String)
- `format` (String) How values are shown in alerts: number, percent, duration, throughput, size.
- `format_input` (String) Unit of the reported value when format is `size`: bit, byte, kilobit, kilobyte, megabyte.
- `no_match_is_zero` (Boolean) Treat missing data as 0. Defaults to false.
- `notifier_ids` (Set of String) Notifiers alerted when the trigger fires. See the appsignal_notifier data source.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tag filters on the metric. Values may contain `*` wildcards.
- `warmup_duration` (Number) Minutes the condition must hold before an alert opens. Defaults to 0.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Id of the current version. It changes on every update.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import appsignal_trigger.queue_depth <app_id>/<trigger_id>
```
